title: guided-diagnostic-journeys-and-autohandoff
author: Alyssa Cheng
release_notes: Adds a guided diagnostic CLI and automated handoff cards for responders; opt-in by default for new installations.
description:
Motivation: First-response time for junior on-call engineers often stalls while they assemble context, meanwhile evidence is lost during handoff. This PR introduces a guided diagnostic "journey" feature that scaffolds stepwise probes, telemetry snapshots and prefilled runbook hints, and ties it to an automated handoff card generator that packages sanitized context for the next responder.

Goals: reduce time-to-first-action, improve handoff signal-to-noise, and provide safe automation with explicit opt-in and redaction policies.

Summary of changes:
- new CLI command `ib diag start|resume|share` to run guided journeys locally or from Slack/web actions
- handoff manager that composes a compact card (2–3 sections) with prioritized hypotheses, key traces, and suggested remediation steps
- privacy engine that redacts secrets/PII via regex + allowlist heuristics before sharing
- web UI: ephemeral handoff card preview and accept/reject flow
- telemetry: new metrics for journey completion, handoff-accepted-rate, and oncall-time-saved
- integration tests and demo runbook templates

rollout checklist:
- [x] CLI surface implemented and feature-flagged
- [x] Hand-off card JSON schema and UI components
- [x] Privacy redaction integration with existing sanitizer
- [x] Unit and e2e tests for happy path and redaction cases
- [x] Docs draft (internal runbooks)

Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1217/guided-diagnostic-journeys and demo video (internal)

NOTE: The description is intentionally compact; implementation details and configuration knobs are in the changed files.
commit_summary: feat(cli): add `diag` subcommand with start/resume/share actions
feat(handoff): new handoff manager to assemble compact cards and push to Slack/email hooks
feat(ui): preview and accept/reject flow for handoff cards (web)
refactor(redaction): unify sanitizer pipeline and add allowlist/denylist patterns
test: add e2e scenario for multi-shift handoff and redaction verification
chore: docs for operators and feature-flag toggles
review_comments: Samir: This looks great overall — can we add a rate limit on share to avoid noisy handoffs during noisy alerts?
Alyssa: Added a short-circuit debounce (30s) in manager.go and documented behavior in the runbook.
Joanna: Suggest tightening the default redaction allowlist; current allowlist may expose hostnames in some environments.
Alyssa: Adjusted allowlist patterns and added integration tests that include obfuscated hostnames. Thanks.
Marcus: E2E flake on CI on the first run; it fails when the mock telemetry store returns partial traces. Can we add a retry?
Alyssa: Added a retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts) and a deterministic seed for the mock; re-ran CI locally.
merge_outcome: Merged after two approvals; release flagged for next patch release and feature behind `guided_diag` feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Feature is feature-flagged (guided_diag=false by default). Operators should enable in staging and validate sanitizer policies before enabling in prod. Watch metrics: incident_bot.journey_completion_ratio and incident_bot.handoff_accepted_rate.
backports_or_followups: Follow-up: add Slack ephemeral attachments for accept/reject UX (ENG-1249)
Backport: prepare a 1.8.x patch for customers on private deploy with opt-in installer toggle
